info.title: Zoom API (baton-zoom surface)
info.description:
The subset of the Zoom API that baton-zoom calls, plus the OAuth token exchange it performs first. Scope is derived from pkg/zoom/client.go and pkg/zoom/helpers.go -- there are no request sites outside that package. Shapes are settled against Zoom's API reference and Zoom's own published OpenAPI document (github.com/zoom/api, openapi.v2.json), with the recorded payloads in pkg/zoom/client_test.go used to confirm response shapes. Response schemas include only the properties the Go structs decode; Zoom returns many more.

Auth: the connector exchanges account credentials for a bearer token at zoom.us/oauth/token (HTTP basic with the client ID and secret) and sends that token as `Authorization: Bearer` on every API request, alongside `Accept: application/json`. GET requests additionally disable uhttp's response cache.

Each operation's required granular scope is recorded in its description, copied from the doc comment on the corresponding client method.

Pagination: Zoom's `page_size` / `next_page_token` scheme. The connector always sends `page_size=50` and forwards `next_page_token` from the previous response; an empty `next_page_token` ends the page loop. `GET /roles` is not paginated.

Rate limiting: every response's rate-limit headers are parsed best-effort into Baton annotations, including on 429 and 5xx, so the retry hints survive failures. Errors are decoded into Zoom's `{code, message}` envelope and specific codes are matched by the callers (1001 user not found, 1005 email already exists, 4131 group member not found, 4138 group admin not found, 4711 missing scope).

servers.description: Zoom API. Overridable with the hidden `--base-url` flag, which is used for tests; path segments are joined onto whatever base is configured.

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: Account-credentials token exchange. Lives on a different host from the API.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Users, synced as user resources (and pending users as invite resources); also the account-provisioning and license-assignment surface.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: User groups, their members, and their administrators.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Account roles and their member assignments.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Base-plan seat counts, used to report license capacity.

post.summary: Exchange account credentials for an access token
post.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:RequestAccessToken. Sent to a different host from the rest of this document (zoom.us, not api.zoom.us) and authenticated with HTTP basic using the configured client ID and secret rather than a bearer token. No API scope is required. The connector reads only `access_token` and fails when it is empty; a 400 whose body carries `error` of `invalid_client` or `invalid_grant` is mapped to an Unauthenticated status.

servers.description: Zoom OAuth host. RequestAccessToken accepts an authURL argument for tests; the connector always passes the empty string, so the default https://zoom.us/oauth/token is used in production.

access_token.description: The only field the connector decodes. Zoom also returns token_type, expires_in, and scope.

4XX.description: OAuth error envelope, decoded into pkg/zoom.OAuthError.

get.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:GetUsers. Required scope: `user:read:list_users:admin`. Called once per status: `active`, then `inactive` when the sync-inactive-users flag is set, and separately with `pending` to build the invite resources.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Always sent by the connector. Zoom defaults to `active` when omitted.

post.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:CreateUser. Required scope: `user:write:user:admin`. Error code 1005 on a 4xx means the email already exists on the account and is handled by the caller.

action.description: How the account is created. `create` emails an activation link; `autoCreate` is for managed domains; `custCreate` produces a user who cannot sign in; `ssoCreate` is for pre-provisioned SSO users.

id.description: Becomes the Baton user resource ID for the new account.

get.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:GetUser. Required scope: `user:read:user:admin`. Used to read `group_ids` when a group-member add returns an ambiguous result, and by license handling. Error code 1001 means the user does not exist.

patch.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:PatchUserLicense. Required scope: `user:update:user:admin`. The connector sends only `type`; Zoom answers 204 with no body. Type 99 (None) is not settable here -- Zoom only accepts it via the ssoCreate action -- so only the PATCH-assignable tiers are modelled.

delete.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:DeleteUser. Required scope: `user:delete:user:admin`. The query parameters are emitted only when the caller sets them (pkg/zoom/helpers.go:deleteUserQuery); with none set the request carries no query string and Zoom applies its default, `disassociate`. Zoom requires `transfer_email` whenever any transfer flag is on; the client does not enforce that.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: `disassociate` unlinks the user but keeps the Zoom user record; `delete` removes the user entirely.

parameters.name: transfer_email
parameters.description: Email of the user who inherits the transferred assets.

parameters.name: transfer_meeting
parameters.description: Sent only as the literal string `true`, and omitted otherwise.

parameters.name: transfer_webinar
parameters.description: Sent only as the literal string `true`, and omitted otherwise.

parameters.name: transfer_recording
parameters.description: Sent only as the literal string `true`, and omitted otherwise.

204.description: Deleted or disassociated. No body decoded.

get.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:GetGroups. Required scope: `group:read:list_groups:admin`. Only `id` and `name` are decoded.

post.summary: Add a user to a group
post.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:EnsureGroupMember. Required scope: `group:write:member:admin` (plus `user:read:user:admin` on the ambiguous path). The connector always posts exactly one member. Zoom answers 201 even when it added nobody, so an `ids` value that does not contain the posted user ID is disambiguated by re-reading the user's `group_ids` via getUser.

members.description: The connector sends a single-element array containing only `id`.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group
delete.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:DeleteGroupMember. Required scope: `group:delete:member:admin`. Error code 4131 means the user was not a member and is treated as already-revoked by the caller.

get.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:GetGroupAdmins. Required scope: `group:read:administrator:admin`. Decoded into the same user struct as listUsers, but Zoom's reference documents only `email` and `name` here -- entries can arrive without an `id`, which the connector handles by matching on email.

post.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:EnsureGroupAdmin. Required scope: `group:write:administrator:admin` (plus `group:read:administrator:admin` on the ambiguous path). One admin per call. When the returned `ids` does not echo the posted user, the connector walks listGroupAdmins to decide whether the assignment already existed, matching on `id` or, for entries without one, on email.

admins.description: The connector sends a single-element array containing only `id`. Zoom also accepts `email` when the ID is unknown.

delete.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:DeleteGroupAdmin. Required scope: `group:delete:administrator:admin`. Error code 4138 means the user was not an administrator and is treated as already-revoked by the caller.

get.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:GetContactGroups. Required scope: `contact_group:read:list_groups:admin`. Note the response key is `groups`, and each element uses `group_id` / `group_name` rather than `id` / `name`.

Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:GetContactGroupMembers. Required scope: `contact_group:read:list_members:admin`. The response key is `group_members`, and a member can be either a user or a user group -- `type` tells them apart.

200.description: A page of contact group members.

get.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:GetRoles. Required scope: `role:read:list_roles:admin`. Not paginated -- the connector sends no query parameters and reads the whole `roles` array in one request.

post.summary: Assign a role to a user
post.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:AssignRole. Required scope: `role:write:member:admin`. Posts a single member; unlike the group mutations the response body is not decoded, so the connector relies on the status code alone.

members.description: The connector sends a single-element array containing only `id`.

201.description: Assigned. The response body is not decoded.

delete.summary: Unassign a role from a user
delete.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:UnassignRole. Required scope: `role:delete:member:admin`. The response body is not decoded.

get.description: Client: pkg/zoom/client.go:GetAccountPlanUsage. Required scope: `billing:read:plan_usage:admin`. The path is fixed on the `me` account alias. Only `plan_base` is decoded; Zoom also returns recording, room, webinar, and other plan blocks that the connector deliberately ignores.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from the account-credentials exchange, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

basicAuth.description: Zoom OAuth client ID and secret, used only on the token endpoint.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Records per page. The connector always sends 50 (pkg/zoom/helpers.go:resourcePageSize).

NextPageToken.name: next_page_token
NextPageToken.description: Opaque page token from the previous response; omitted on the first request. Zoom expires these after 15 minutes.

UserId.name: userId
UserId.description: Zoom user ID. The connector passes the canonical `id`, never an email.

GroupId.name: groupId
GroupId.description: Group ID -- the user group's `id` for /groups paths, or the contact group's `group_id` for /contacts/groups paths.

RoleId.name: roleId
RoleId.description: Role ID as returned by listRoles.

APIError.description: Zoom's structured error envelope, decoded into pkg/zoom.APIError. The raw body and status code are preserved alongside the parsed fields so callers can match on specific codes.

MembershipMutation.description: Zoom's group member/admin add response. `ids` is a comma-delimited list of the IDs the call actually created, so it is empty when the call created nothing -- which is why the connector treats a 201 as inconclusive and verifies membership separately.

Pagination.description: Zoom's standard page metadata (pkg/zoom.PaginationData). Only `next_page_token` drives the connector's paging.

UserType.description: License tier: 1 Basic, 2 Licensed, 4 Unassigned without Meetings Basic, 99 None. Enum taken from Zoom's current users reference as cited in pkg/zoom/models.go; Zoom's 2018 published spec still lists the retired 1/2/3 set.

PatchableUserType.description: The license tiers the connector can assign via PATCH /users/{userId}. Type 99 (None) is excluded because Zoom only accepts it through the ssoCreate action.

User.description: The user projection this connector decodes (pkg/zoom.User). Used for listUsers, getUser, createUser confirmation, and the group administrators list -- not every field is populated on every endpoint.

id.description: Canonical user ID; the Baton user resource ID. Absent on some group-administrator entries, which the connector detects and falls back to email matching.

status.description: Mapped to the Baton user status; `pending` users are surfaced as invite resources instead of users.

role_id.description: Role assignment used to build the role grants.

group_ids.description: Group memberships. Read after an ambiguous group-member add to decide whether the user already belonged.

Group.description: A user group (pkg/zoom.Group). Zoom also returns total_members, which the connector ignores.

group_privacy.description: 1 visible and searchable by anyone; 2 visible to members only, searchable by anyone; 3 visible and searchable by members only.

ContactGroupMember.description: A contact group member (pkg/zoom.GroupMember), which may be a user or a user group.

id.description: User ID when type is 1, user group ID when type is 2. Source of the contact-group membership grants.
Baton role resource ID and the path parameter for the assignment operations.

ids.description: Comma-delimited IDs that this call created. Empty when nothing was created. Matched with exact token comparison so `user-1` does not match `user-10`.

added_at.description: Returned by Zoom but not decoded by the connector.

pending.description: Seats queued by an admin but not yet applied.

code.description: Zoom error code. Matched by callers: 1001 user not found, 1005 email already exists, 4131 group member not found, 4138 group admin not found, 4711 missing scope.

error.description: `invalid_client` and `invalid_grant` on a 400 are mapped to an Unauthenticated status.
